SELECT type_code, type_name, transaction_category, fee_policy, refund_capability, status, status_type, FORMATDATETIME(updated_at, 'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss') AS updatedAt FROM t_ops_payment_type ORDER BY id ASC

SELECT template_code, template_name, terminal_type, default_pay_method, display_policy, status, status_type, FORMATDATETIME(updated_at, 'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss') AS updatedAt FROM t_ops_cashier_template ORDER BY id ASC

SELECT channel_code, channel_name, channel_type, merchant_profile, refund_sla, risk_tag, status, status_type, FORMATDATETIME(updated_at, 'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss') AS updatedAt FROM t_ops_channel_profile ORDER BY id ASC

SELECT route_code, business_code, pay_type, primary_channel, backup_channel, match_policy, status, status_type, FORMATDATETIME(updated_at, 'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss') AS updatedAt FROM t_ops_routing_rule ORDER BY id ASC

SELECT business_code AS businessCode, business_name AS businessName, default_scene AS defaultScene, owner, settlement_policy AS settlementPolicy, status, status_type AS statusType, FORMATDATETIME(updated_at, 'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss') AS updatedAt FROM t_ops_business_line WHERE status = 'ENABLED' AND business_code = #{businessCode} LIMIT 1

SELECT type_code AS typeCode, type_name AS typeName, transaction_category AS transactionCategory, fee_policy AS feePolicy, refund_capability AS refundCapability, status, status_type AS statusType, FORMATDATETIME(updated_at, 'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss') AS updatedAt FROM t_ops_payment_type WHERE status = 'ENABLED' AND type_code = #{typeCode} LIMIT 1

SELECT template_code AS templateCode, template_name AS templateName, terminal_type AS terminalType, default_pay_method AS defaultPayMethod, display_policy AS displayPolicy, status, status_type AS statusType, FORMATDATETIME(updated_at, 'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss') AS updatedAt FROM t_ops_cashier_template WHERE status = 'ENABLED' AND terminal_type = #{terminalType} ORDER BY id ASC LIMIT 1

SELECT channel_code AS channelCode, channel_name AS channelName, channel_type AS channelType, merchant_profile AS merchantProfile, refund_sla AS refundSla, risk_tag AS riskTag, status, status_type AS statusType, FORMATDATETIME(updated_at, 'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss') AS updatedAt FROM t_ops_channel_profile WHERE status = 'ENABLED' AND channel_code = #{channelCode} LIMIT 1

SELECT route_code AS routeCode, business_code AS businessCode, pay_type AS payType, primary_channel AS primaryChannel, backup_channel AS backupChannel, match_policy AS matchPolicy, status, status_type AS statusType, FORMATDATETIME(updated_at, 'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss') AS updatedAt FROM t_ops_routing_rule WHERE status = 'ENABLED' AND business_code = #{businessCode} AND pay_type = #{payType} ORDER BY id ASC LIMIT 1

SELECT control_code AS controlCode, control_name AS controlName, control_scope AS controlScope, control_value AS controlValue, risk_level AS riskLevel, status, status_type AS statusType, FORMATDATETIME(updated_at, 'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss') AS updatedAt FROM t_ops_system_control WHERE status = 'ENABLED' ORDER BY id ASC
SELECT version_no FROM t_ops_config_snapshot_version ORDER BY version_no DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT version_no FROM t_ops_config_snapshot_version WHERE source_request_no = #{sourceRequestNo} LIMIT 1

SELECT event_no AS eventNo, snapshot_version AS snapshotVersion, gray_scope AS grayScope, status, source_request_no AS sourceRequestNo, created_at AS createdAt, acknowledged_by AS acknowledgedBy, acknowledged_at AS acknowledgedAt FROM t_ops_config_refresh_event ORDER BY id DESC
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM t_ops_agreement_template WHERE status = 'ENABLED'
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM t_ops_business_line WHERE status = 'ENABLED'
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM t_ops_payment_type WHERE status = 'ENABLED'
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM t_ops_channel_profile WHERE status = 'ENABLED'

SELECT request_no AS requestNo, config_type AS configType, config_code AS configCode, target_status AS targetStatus, reason, gray_scope AS grayScope, gray_start_at AS grayStartAt, gray_end_at AS grayEndAt, applicant, approver, approval_comment AS approvalComment, status, status_type AS statusType, created_at AS createdAt, approved_at AS approvedAt, published_at AS publishedAt FROM t_ops_config_change ORDER BY id DESC

SELECT request_no AS requestNo, config_type AS configType, config_code AS configCode, target_status AS targetStatus, reason, gray_scope AS grayScope, gray_start_at AS grayStartAt, gray_end_at AS grayEndAt, applicant, approver, approval_comment AS approvalComment, status, status_type AS statusType, created_at AS createdAt, approved_at AS approvedAt, published_at AS publishedAt FROM t_ops_config_change WHERE request_no = #{requestNo} LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_ops_config_change ( request_no, config_type, config_code, target_status, reason, gray_scope, gray_start_at, gray_end_at, applicant, status, status_type, created_at ) VALUES ( #{requestNo}, #{configType}, #{configCode}, #{targetStatus}, #{reason}, #{grayScope}, #{grayStartAt}, #{grayEndAt}, #{applicant}, 'PENDING_APPROVAL', 'warn', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP )
mapper.update: UPDATE t_ops_config_change SET status = #{status}, status_type = #{statusType}, approver = #{approver}, approval_comment = #{approvalComment}, approved_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE request_no = #{requestNo} AND status = 'PENDING_APPROVAL'
UPDATE t_ops_config_change SET status = 'PUBLISHED', status_type = 'success', published_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE request_no = #{requestNo} AND status = 'APPROVED'
UPDATE t_ops_config_change SET status = 'EXPIRED', status_type = 'danger' WHERE request_no = #{requestNo} AND status = 'APPROVED'
UPDATE t_ops_config_refresh_event SET status = 'ACKNOWLEDGED', acknowledged_by = #{acknowledgedBy}, acknowledged_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE event_no = #{eventNo} AND status = 'PENDING'
